content.text:
I submitted **index 22 (Cr 0.23 / Sb 0.77)** as the best composition. Its EQE is 0.0147%, the highest of the three I measured. I used all 3 merit measurements and 4 of the 5 XRD scans.

| Index | Cr / Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 14 | 0.48 / 0.52 | 0.0026 |
| 19 | 0.33 / 0.67 | 0.0045 |
| 22 | 0.23 / 0.77 | 0.0147 |

**What the XRD showed:**
- **Index 5 (Cr-rich):** a secondary Cr₂O₃ phase is present. I didn't spend merit measurements on that end of the library.
- **Index 14 (near 1:1):** a single rutile-type CrSbO₄ phase.
- **Indices 20 and 22 (Sb-rich):** the rutile peak shifts to lower Q, meaning the lattice expands. A minor extra phase appears too, probably an Sb oxide. It didn't stop EQE from rising.

**Uncertainty:** EQE rose steadily with more Sb and was still climbing at index 22. Budget ran out before I could measure anything more Sb-rich, so indices 23–27 may do better. Index 22 is the best I measured, but it may not be the best in the library.
